verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सस्मितं मधुसूदनः। प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं वरेण्यः प्रभुरीश्वरः॥१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: भारते भारतवर्षे कार्यगुरुः गुरु महत्कार्यमस्यास्तीति कार्यगुरुः। आहिताग्न्यादित्वात्पूर्वनिपातः। चक्षुरिव सत्पथप्रकाशकः॥८६॥

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यस्य हितार्थाय यन्मां वदसि नारद। तस्य सम्यक्प्रवृत्तस्य श्रूयतामुत्तरं वचः॥२॥
verses.english: You are capable of ordering anyone to give measure for measure… let my cows be returned to me so that I will return to my abode, namely the ocean…
verses.bhavadeepa: पञ्चपञ्चाशकेऽध्याये नारदस्य च सान्त्वनम्। ब्रह्मणोक्तं विभोर्जन्म स्थानं चापि निरूप्यते॥१॥ नारदस्य वरेण्यः भोगमोक्षकामैर्वरणीयः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: विदिता देहिनो जाता मयैते भुवि दानवाः। यां च यस्तनुमादाय दैत्यः पुष्यति विग्रहम्॥३॥
verses.english: If punishment is not meted out on the powerful personalities, who knowingly or unknowingly drag things to their side, then the praiseworthiness of the wielder of the sceptre on world is at stake…

verses.sanskrit: जानामि कंसं सम्भूतमुग्रसेनसुतं भुवि। केशिनं चापि जानामि दैत्यं तुरगविग्रहम्॥४॥
verses.english: Oh, brAhmaNa nArada, I know the whereabouts of demons खर and प्रलम्ब… further, I am aware about the secret of emperor बलि’स् daughter becoming the demoness called पूतन, the child-minder… I know that great serpent कालीय entered the lake of यमुन and he is living in there just out of fear from lady विनत’स् son, गरुड… I am aware the जरा-सन्ध has become the head of all kings; and about the demon नरक living in the city of प्राग्ज्योतिष-पुरम्; and about demon बाण, an energetic, haughty and ambidextrous demon invincible even unto the gods because his valour equals that of गुह, aka कार्तिकेय, and about that demon’s living in शोणित-पुर on earth, at present… I know that भारती, the mother earth, is overstuffed with this junk and she is counting on me to ease her burden…

verses.sanskrit: नागं कुवलयापीडं मल्लौ चाणूरमुष्टिकौ। अरिष्टं चापि जानामि दैत्यं वृषभरूपिणम्॥५॥
verses.english: While you bide your time as a child with charmy eyes in that village of cowmen, all the elderly will tend to become elvish lads or lasses just for divine dalliance…

verses.sanskrit: विदितो मे खरश्चैव प्रलम्बश्च महासुरः। सा च मे विदिता विप्र पूतना दुहिता बलेः॥६॥
verses.english: I will now enter into a cathartic yoga, for myself and for others too, and reach the human world transmuting myself as a human… in the process of depurating the earth I myself will eradicate kaMsa and other demon-tuned-humans employing those and those methods seemly for me; or I will employ chosen-few for that on deciding who is to be felled at whose hand; then, whether the demons are afore or afar; or skulking and sidling into disguises or disappearances by the dint of their yoga, it is incumbent on me to trail them for their neutralisation; and with such and such operations of mine the demons will come to order, individually or severally…

verses.sanskrit: कालियं चापि जानामि यमुनाह्रदगोचरम्। वैनतेयभयाद्यस्तु यमुनाह्रदमाविशत्॥७॥
verses.english: Indeed, the god-haters are to be liquidated in a given battle… remember, oh, nArada, that the incarnations of gods, celestials, sages, gandharvA-s et al for the sake of mother earth, and their departure from here to earth, everything is just with my consent… hence, oh, नारद, all this is my foregone conclusion…” replying nArada, now विष्णु turned to brahma and spoke:

verses.sanskrit: विदितो मे जरासन्धः स्थितो मूर्ध्नि महीक्षिताम्। प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरे वापि नरकं साधु तर्कये॥८॥
verses.english: Oh, brAhmaNa nArada, I know the whereabouts of demons खर and प्रलम्ब… further, I am aware about the secret of emperor बलि’स् daughter becoming the demoness called पूतन, the child-minder… I know that great serpent कालीय entered the lake of यमुन and he is living in there just out of fear from lady विनत’स् son, गरुड… I am aware the जरा-सन्ध has become the head of all kings; and about the demon नरक living in the city of प्राग्ज्योतिष-पुरम्; and about demon बाण, an energetic, haughty and ambidextrous demon invincible even unto the gods because his valour equals that of गुह, aka कार्तिकेय, and about that demon’s living in शोणित-पुर on earth, at present… I know that भारती, the mother earth, is overstuffed with this junk and she is counting on me to ease her burden…

verses.sanskrit: मानुषे पार्थिवे लोके मानुषत्वमुपागतम्। बाणं च शोणितपुरे गुहप्रतिमतेजसम्॥९॥
verses.english: “O lord nArAyaNa, hear from me about the key to your success, which earthly mother will deliver you, in which dynasty you are going to take birth as an enricher of that dynasty, as to how you are going to uphold the great lineage of यादवा-s, as to how you will make your lineage flourish on eliminating demons, as to how you will re-establish decorum in human world… all these aspects you may know from me…

verses.sanskrit: दृप्तं बाहुसहस्रेण देवैरपि सुदुर्जयम्। मय्यासक्तां च जानामि भारतीं महतीं धुरम्॥१०॥
verses.english: In the days of yore, oh nArAyaNa, when the high-souled raingod वरुण is conducting a vedic-ritual, कश्यप-प्रजापति impounded all the milch-cows belonging to वरुण witch gave milk for that ritual… two wives f कश्यप-प्रजापति, namely lady अदिति and lady सुरभि, refused to return those cows to वरुण, though he repeatedly implored them for their return…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तच्च विजानामि यथा यास्यन्ति ते नृपाः। क्षयो भुवि मया दृष्टः शक्रलोके च सत्क्रिया। एषां पुरुषदेहानामपरावृत्तदेहिनाम्॥११॥
verses.english: I also know as to how these demons-turned-kings, when neutralised on earth, will pass across the barrier called life – जन्म-राहित्यम् – or, otherwise like ditching to netherworlds, अथो-लोक-जीवनम्; at the same time keeping the heavens of इन्द्र unsullied; still and all, without any boomerang of their existence in any form or physique within any holy precincts…

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्रवेक्ष्याम्यहं योगमात्मनश्च परस्य च। सम्प्राप्य पार्थिवं लोकं मानुषत्वमुपागतः॥१२॥
verses.english: Though his object of confiscating cows is accomplished sage कश्यप has not ordered the return of those kine to me, just by falling in the clutches of his two wives अदिति and सुरभि…।
verses.bhavadeepa: क्षय इति। एषां कंसादीनां भुवि क्षयः शक्रलोकसत्क्रिया च मया कारुणिकेन दृष्टा आलोचितास्त्येव। अपरावृत्तः पुनर्भुवमप्रविष्टो देही प्राणो येषां तेषाम्॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: कम्सादींश्चापि तत्सर्वान्वधिष्यामि महासुरान्। तेन तेन विधानेन येन यः शान्तिमेष्यति॥१३॥
verses.english: Who is capable of laying his hand on my cows, which yield best milk similar to ambrosia, barring sage कश्यप…
verses.bhavadeepa: योगम् उद्यमं प्रवेक्ष्यामि अन्तर्यामितया बहिर्यामितया च उत्तम्भयामि। पार्थिवं पृथिवीविकारं लोकं देहम्॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: अनुप्रविश्य योगेन तास्ता हि गतयो मया। अमीषां हि सुरेन्द्राणां हन्तव्या रिपवो युधि॥१४॥
verses.english: Who is capable of laying his hand on my cows, which yield best milk similar to ambrosia, barring sage कश्यप…

verses.sanskrit: जगत्यर्थे कृतो योऽयमंशोत्सर्गो दिवौकसैः। सुरदेवर्षिगन्धर्वैरितश्चानुमते मम॥१५॥
verses.english: As a supreme refuge of ours, oh, brahma, it up to you to control anyone who has gone astray, whether he is master, guru or whoever he may be…

verses.sanskrit: विनिश्चयो हि प्रागेव नारदायं कृतो मया। निवासं ननु मे ब्रह्मन्विदधातु पितामहः॥१६॥
verses.english: If punishment is not meted out on the powerful personalities, who knowingly or unknowingly drag things to their side, then the praiseworthiness of the wielder of the sceptre on world is at stake…

verses.sanskrit: यत्र देशे यथा जातो येन वेषेण वा वसन्। तानहं समरे हन्यां तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥१७॥
verses.english: Mantle yourself with your own illusive power which is nothing but your yogic dimension, and alight on earth for the well-being of the world…

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मोवाच।
              नारायणेमं सिद्धार्थमुपायं शृणु मे विभो। भुवि यस्ते जनयिता जननी च भविष्यति॥१८॥
यत्र त्वं च महाबाहो जातः कुलकरो भुवि। यादवानां महद्वंशमखिलं धारयिष्यसि॥१९॥
verses.english: Those cows that are the goddesses of my soul needs must be protected, for they protect brAhmaNA-s for the conduct of vedic rituals, who in turn protect the world through conducting vedic-rituals… protecting cows and brAhmaNA-s is said to be the protection of world, isn’t it…

verses.sanskrit: तांश्चासुरान्समुत्पाट्य वंशं कृत्वात्मनो महत्। स्थापयिष्यसि मर्यादां नृणां तन्मे निशामय॥२०॥
verses.english: As a supreme refuge of ours, oh, brahma, it up to you to control anyone who has gone astray, whether he is master, guru or whoever he may be…

verses.sanskrit: पुरा हि कश्यपो विष्णो वरुणस्य महात्मनः। जहार यज्ञिया गा वै पयोदास्तु महामखे॥२१॥
verses.english: That cowman renowned as वसु-देव, selfsame to sage कश्यप in his resplendence, will have his mainstay in livestock while he is on earth, staying in the vicinage of Mt. गो-वर्धन, not very far from मथुर city… he will be a rearer of cattle and payer of annual tribute to king कंस… he will have two wives namely lady देवकि and lady रोहिणि who are none else that lady अदिति and lady सुरभि, the wives of sage कश्यप…
verses.bhavadeepa: समुत्पाट्य उन्मूल्य महत् माहात्म्यं यश इति यावत्॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: अदितिः सुरभिश्चैते द्वे भार्ये कश्यपस्य तु। प्रदीयमाना गास्तास्तु नैच्छतां वरुणस्य वै॥२२॥
verses.english: In the first instance – आदौ - you will become a youngling of those ladies, because you will have two phases in your span on earth, one in your childhood another in middle-age; and flourish with all the attributes of a cowboy in the first phase, for you have to be something like - जे ने सैस् क़ुओइ, as you have flourished as a dwarf-son of the same कश्यप-अदिति pair in your triple- treader incarnation with a similar जे ने सैस् क़ुओइ insofar as emperor बलि is concerned…

verses.sanskrit: ततो मां वरुणोऽभ्येत्य प्रणम्य शिरसा ततः। उवाच भगवन्गावो गुरुणा मे हृता इति॥२३॥
verses.english: Thereupon varuNa approached me in a bow and scrape manner and said to me: "O revered one, the sage काश्यप appropriated all my kine…

verses.sanskrit: कृतकार्यो हि गास्तास्तु नानुजानाति मे गुरुः। अन्ववर्तत भार्ये द्वे अदितिं सुरभिं तथा॥२४॥
verses.english: Though his object of confiscating cows is accomplished sage कश्यप has not ordered the return of those kine to me, just by falling in the clutches of his two wives अदिति and सुरभि…।

verses.sanskrit: मम ता ह्यक्षया गवो दिव्याः कामदुहः प्रभो। चरन्ति सगर्ण्न्सर्वान्रक्षिताः स्वेन तेजसा॥२५॥
verses.english: All those kine of mine give heavenly and eternal milk whenever wished… protected by their own capability they range up to the fringes of all seas uncaught by any…

verses.sanskrit: कस्ता धर्षयितुं शक्तो मम गाः कश्यपादृते। अक्षयं या क्षरन्त्यग्र्यं पयो देवामृतोपमम्॥२६॥
verses.english: While you perambulate in woods tending kine, oh विष्णु, those cattle marking the garland of holy basil leaves secured on your chest will feast their eyes on your deiform...

verses.sanskrit: प्रभुर्वा व्युत्थितो ब्रह्मन्गुरुर्वा यदि वेतरः। त्वया नियम्याः सर्वे वै त्वं हि नः परमा गतिः॥२७॥
verses.english: While you bide your time as a child with charmy eyes in that village of cowmen, all the elderly will tend to become elvish lads or lasses just for divine dalliance…

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रभवतां दण्डो लोके कार्यमजानताम्। न विद्यते लोकगुरोर्न स्युर्वै लोकसेतवः॥२८॥
verses.english: When you are in the village of cowherds, all the cowmen, or cowboys will become your votaries; whether they go to woods with you for tending cows, or messing around the cowsheds in the village itself, or when ducking in the water of river यमुन, they conduct themselves according to your wish, wishing to become your fawners all the time, they luxuriate thus in your company… in this way, blest is the entity of कश्यप-प्रजाप्ति in the incarnation of your human-father, वसु-देव…

verses.sanskrit: यथा वास्तु तथा वास्तु कर्तव्ये भगवन्प्रभुः। मम गावः प्रदीयन्तां ततो गन्तास्मि सागरम्॥२९॥
verses.english: Or what father is there of you, an unbegotten entity, to address “yes, father…” when he addresses you “oh, my son…” excepting कश्यप-प्रजापति… or else, whose paternity you consider fair…

verses.sanskrit: या आत्मदेवता गावो या गावः सत्त्वमव्ययम्। लोकानां त्वत्प्रवृत्तानामेकं गोब्राह्मणं स्मृतम्॥३०॥
verses.english: So far as mothering you is concerned, who else can conceive you, because whole universe is conceived in you, excepting lady अदिति? Therefore by your self-begotten yoga please proceed for victory, O मधुसुदन… we the gods too repair to our respective habitations…” so said brahma to विष्णु…

verses.sanskrit: त्रातव्याः प्रथमं गावस्त्रातास्त्रायन्ति ता द्विजान्। गोब्राह्मणपरित्राणे परित्रातं जगद्भवेत्॥३१॥
verses.english: Those cows that are the goddesses of my soul needs must be protected, for they protect brAhmaNA-s for the conduct of vedic rituals, who in turn protect the world through conducting vedic-rituals… protecting cows and brAhmaNA-s is said to be the protection of world, isn’t it…

verses.sanskrit: इत्यम्बुपतिना प्रोक्तो वरुणेनाहमच्युत। गवां करणतत्त्वज्ञः कश्यपे शापमुत्सृजम्॥३२॥
येनांशेन हृता गावः कश्यपेन महर्षिणा। स तेनांशेन जगति गत्वा गोपत्वमेष्यति॥३३॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the fifty-fifth chapter of first canto called harivamsha - parva, in harivamsha -purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating brahma’s reply to विष्णु।

verses.sanskrit: या च सा सुरभिर्नाम अदितिश्च सुरारणिः। तेऽप्युभे तस्य भार्ये वै तेनैव सह यास्यतः॥३४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: कश्यपस्य एकोंऽशो नन्दोऽपरो वसुदेव इत्याशयेनाह- येनांशेनेति। गोपत्वं नन्दत्वम्॥३३॥

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां च सह गोपत्वे कश्यपो भुवि रंस्यते। स तस्य कश्यपस्यांशस्तेजसा कश्यपोपमः॥३५॥
वसुदेव इति ख्यातो गोषु तिष्ठति भूतले। गिरिर्गोवर्धनो नाम मथुरायास्त्वदूरतः॥३६॥
verses.bhavadeepa: स प्रसिद्धोऽन्यो यस्तस्य कश्यपस्यांशः स वसुदेवः गोषु गोपालेषु अधिपतित्वेन तिष्ठति॥३५॥

verses.sanskrit: तत्रासौ गोषु निरतः कंसस्य करदायकः। तस्य भार्याद्वयं जातमदितिः सुरभिश्च ते॥३७॥
देवकी रोहिणी चेमे वसुदेवस्य धीमतः। सुरभी रोहिणी देवी चादितिर्देवकी त्वभूत्॥३८॥
verses.bhavadeepa: तस्येति। अदितेरपि यशोदादेवकीभेदेन द्वे रूपे द्रष्टव्ये कश्यपवत् गोष्वित्यनुषङ्गात्॥३७॥

verses.sanskrit: तत्र त्वं शिशुरेवादौ गोपालकृतलक्षणः। वर्ध्यस्व महाबाहो पुरा त्रैविक्रमे यथा॥३९॥
छादयित्वात्मनात्मानं मायया योगरूपया। तत्रावतर लोकानां भवाय मधुसूदन॥४०॥
जयाशीर्वचनैस्त्वैते वर्धयन्ति दिवौकसः॥४१॥
verses.english: With hail-hos and blessings all the gods are pepping you up… come on, make it happen…

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानमात्मना हि त्वमवतार्य महीतले। देवकीं रोहिणीं चैव गर्भाभ्यां परितोषय। गोपकन्यासहस्राणि रमयंश्चर मेदिनीम्॥४२॥
verses.english: Let your inner self alight on earth causing delight to the doting motherly affections of lady देवकि and lady रोहिणि… besides, you will be milling around on earth with thousands of milkmaids as a swain making the voluptuous damsels huddling around you…

verses.sanskrit: गाश्च ते रक्षतो विष्णो वनानि परिधावतः। वनमालापरिक्षिप्तं धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति ते वपुः॥४३॥
verses.english: While you perambulate in woods tending kine, oh विष्णु, those cattle marking the garland of holy basil leaves secured on your chest will feast their eyes on your deiform...

verses.sanskrit: विष्णौ पद्मपलाशाक्षे गोपालवसतिं गते। बाले त्वयि महाबाहो लोको बालत्वमेष्यति॥४४॥
त्वद्भक्ताः पुण्डरीकाक्ष तव चित्तवशानुगाः। गोषु गोपा भविष्यन्ति सहायाः सततं तव। वने चारयतो गाश्च गोष्ठेषु परिधावतः॥४५॥
मज्जतो यमुनायां च रतिं प्राप्स्यन्ति ते त्वयि। जीवितं वसुदेवस्य भविष्यति सुजीवितम्॥४६॥
verses.english: When you are in the village of cowherds, all the cowmen, or cowboys will become your votaries; whether they go to woods with you for tending cows, or messing around the cowsheds in the village itself, or when ducking in the water of river यमुन, they conduct themselves according to your wish, wishing to become your fawners all the time, they luxuriate thus in your company… in this way, blest is the entity of कश्यप-प्रजाप्ति in the incarnation of your human-father, वसु-देव…

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वया तात इत्युक्तः स पुत्र इति वक्ष्यति। अथवा कस्य पुत्रत्वं गच्छेथाः कश्यपादृते॥४७॥
verses.english: Or what father is there of you, an unbegotten entity, to address “yes, father…” when he addresses you “oh, my son…” excepting कश्यप-प्रजापति… or else, whose paternity you consider fair…

verses.sanskrit: का च धारयितुं शक्ता त्वं विष्णो अदितिं विना। योगेनात्मसमुत्थेन गच्छ त्वं विजयाय वै। वयमप्यालयान्स्वान्स्वान्गच्छामो मधुसूदन॥४८॥
verses.english: So far as mothering you is concerned, who else can conceive you, because whole universe is conceived in you, excepting lady अदिति? Therefore by your self-begotten yoga please proceed for victory, O मधुसुदन… we the gods too repair to our respective habitations…” so said brahma to विष्णु…

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              स देवानभ्यनुज्ञाय विविक्ते त्रिदिवालये। जगाम विष्णुः स्वं देशं क्षीरोदस्योत्तरां दिशम्॥४९॥
तत्र वै पार्वती नाम गुहा मेरोः सुदुर्गमा। त्रिभिस्तस्यैव विक्रान्तैर्नित्यं पर्वसु पूजिता॥५०॥
पुराणं तत्र विन्यस्य देहं हरिरुदारधीः। आत्मानं योजयामास वसुदेवगृहे प्रभुः॥५१॥
